evals.prompt: In the supplied source.md, change only the top-level title property from Old title to Researcher's revised title. Save the complete candidate as result.md in the evaluation working directory. Use the supplied skill instructions and inspect the raw source before editing. This is a disposable artifact exercise; do not edit application code or other files. Briefly report what you verified and what this exercise cannot establish.
evals.expected_output: Produces the requested string-valued title and proves byte preservation outside its scalar range using the complete supplied source; claims only bounded artifact evidence.
assertions: Changes the top-level title rather than repeated title text in a nested mapping, multiline value or body.
Preserves every byte outside the authorized scalar, including BOM, CRLF, comments, unknown data, Unicode bytes and absent final newline.
Reparses the complete candidate to verify the intended string value and other mapping values.
Does not claim that this artifact exercise verifies the application transactional writer or full product behavior.

evals.prompt: 用户编辑期间外部程序替换了同一个文件；不要静默覆盖，也不要把冲突处理写进 YAML parser。
evals.expected_output: Keeps source fidelity as the byte-semantics owner and routes the external participant, revision, and recovery boundary to vault-file-coordination and trust as needed.
assertions: Does not normalize or rewrite source merely to resolve the conflict.
Preserves the starting buffer and current disk bytes as distinct recoverable values.
Does not make parsing logic an authorization or conflict owner.

evals.prompt: A source-save test compares output and expected after CRLF-to-LF normalization. An unrelated title edit is reported, but no field or payload is supplied. Review what this test proves and specify adequate proof without inventing a patch.
evals.expected_output: Identifies an inadequate preservation oracle and missing edit scope.
assertions: Does not infer full-source authority from a visible title edit.
Separates exact unchanged-byte assertions from intended semantic validation.
Does not invent an exact title mutation absent the payload.
